evidence.value: Forecast Rs 2,762 (+2.6%) vs holding cost 1.8% -> edge +0.8%
evidence.test: edge >= +3%: +2 | >= +1%: +1 | <= -1%: -1 | <= -3%: -2 (capped at 1 point: backtest error 4.5% is not better than no-change 3.8%)
evidence.source: WheatWise forecast (backtest error 4.55% vs no-change 3.77%, 244 tests)
evidence.why: Stocking only pays if the expected rise beats interest + godown + losses.

evidence.value: Prices in Dec are usually +1.3% vs Oct
evidence.source: Seasonal index from 11 years of Agmarknet data (85% weight, rest = typical pattern)
evidence.why: Wheat is cheapest at harvest (Apr-May) and dearest in the lean months (Dec-Feb).

evidence.value: 7-day avg Rs 2,705 vs 30-day avg Rs 2,688; 30-day change -0.1%
evidence.why: Prices tend to keep moving the way they are moving for a few weeks.

evidence.value: Today is higher than 90% of the last year's days (range Rs 2,137 - Rs 2,884)
evidence.why: Buying in the cheap part of the yearly range limits risk.
A very fast rise/fall often pauses or reverses.
Near MSP, FCI procurement supports prices - downside is limited.

msp.note: history = which MSP was the floor on each date (used to replay past days fairly). Each Sep/Oct the Cabinet announces the next MSP: add a row for 1 Mar next year and update value/next_value.

freight.note: Truck freight assumption (Rs 3.0 per tonne-km). Replace with your transporter's real quote - or set freight_override on a market.

costs.note: Mandi fee (MP mandi tax ~1.5% + nirashrit ~0.2%), loading/unloading, gunny bags, commission.

carrying.note: Cost of holding stock: interest on money, godown rent, moisture/rodent loss. A buy-and-hold only pays if the price rise beats this.

business.note: Andhra Pradesh has no wheat mandi data (AP buys wheat from other states), so Srikakulam prices are worked out as source-mandi price + mandi fee + freight + handling.

msp.note: history = which MSP was the floor on each date (used to replay past days fairly). Each Sep/Oct the Cabinet announces the next MSP: add a row for 1 Mar next year and update value/next_value.

omss.note: FCI Open Market Sale Scheme (OMSS) wheat reserve price in Rs/qtl. When FCI is selling, open-market prices rarely stay much above this + freight. Set reserve_price and active_from (YYYY-MM-DD, first auction) when sales start; set both back to null when they stop.

freight.note: Truck freight assumption (Rs 3.0 per tonne-km). Replace with your transporter's real quote - or set freight_override on a market.

costs.note: Mandi fee (MP mandi tax ~1.5% + nirashrit ~0.2%), loading/unloading, gunny bags, commission.

carrying.note: Cost of holding stock: interest on money, godown rent, moisture/rodent loss. A buy-and-hold only pays if the price rise beats this.
